cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time,subprocess
raw='MESSAGE sip:d@d.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:a@alias.test>\r\nTo: <sip:d@d.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n'
jobs=[]
for i in range(2048):
 jobs.append({'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'u'},'trusted_out':bool(i%2),'raw':raw})
b={'directory':{'sip:a@local.test':['sip:a@alias.test']},'accounts':{'u':{'primary':'sip:a@local.test','allow':[]}},'gateways':{'g':{'local_domains':['local.test'],'peers':{}}},'jobs':jobs}
data=json.dumps(b,separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('input',len(data))
t=time.time(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','submission/gateway.py'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); print('time',time.time()-t,'rc',p.returncode,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:200])
r=json.loads(p.stdout); print(len(r['results']),r['results'][0]['status'])
